posts.quoted_text:
@levelsio But Europe has 35 hour work week, two weeks paid vacation, free healthcare, free education..and homeless shelters, food stamps.

Meanwhile China has none of that, because China only spends 8% of its GDP on welfare. https://t.co/eLwZD2pFU0
posts.text:
There seems to be an inverse correlation with spending money on social welfare and your economy's growth

It's like repeatedly spoiling a child, they'll just want more and more and will never be satisfied

Instead of teaching the importance of frugality, the value of money and not wasting it
posts.text_zh:
社会福利支出和经济增长之间似乎存在负相关

这就像一再溺爱一个孩子，他们只会要得越来越多，永远不会满足

与其教导节俭的重要性、金钱的价值以及不要浪费

posts.author: levelsio
posts.quoted_text: JUST IN: German minister proposes a new tax on all economic value created by AI.
posts.text:
Yesterday France announced tax of €0.055 per GB on internet traffic

Today Germany is considering taxing all AI-generated revenue

You will see European countries keep clawing more and more money from foreign companies as they are slowly running out of money themselves to pay for their pensions and welfare state

Add to this the planned wealth taxes and exit taxes on any European who will try to leave (already active in many EU countries)

Europe is running out of money
posts.text_zh:
昨天法国宣布对互联网流量按每 GB 0.055 欧元征税

今天德国在考虑对所有 AI 产生的收入征税

你会看到欧洲国家不断从外国公司那里榨取越来越多的钱，因为它们自己正在慢慢没钱支付养老金和福利国家的开销

再加上计划中的财富税，以及对任何试图离开的欧洲人征收的离境税（已在许多欧盟国家生效）

欧洲正在没钱
